svg.title: Colophon
svg.desc: Colophon: a caseback window with the winding rotor swinging. Every mark above is typeset code: drawn as SVG by Python that ships in this repository, set in Bodoni Moda and Martian Mono under the SIL Open Font License and outlined into paths. Figures come from each project's own README and illustrations say so. The ledger is redrawn weekly and the wager moves with every visitor. Calibre FKR-26, 2026, Hyderabad.
